# DateIntervalSpecification

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> 

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `DateIntervalSpecificationInspection`

`new DateInterval($spec)` throws for a malformed ISO-8601 duration string.
Check literal specifications against the accepted shapes so the mistake is
caught before runtime.

## Example

```php{5,8,9,10,11,12,13}
<?php
function intervals($mode)
{
    $weekly = 'P1W';
    $broken = '1W';

    return [
        new DateInterval('3M'),
        new DateInterval('P2D1Y'),
        new DateInterval('PT1D'),
        new DateInterval("PT"),
        new DateInterval('PT10:30:00'),
        new DateInterval('p1d'),
        new DateInterval($weekly),
        new DateInterval($broken),
        new DateInterval("P{$mode}D"),
        new DateInterval('P1Y2M3DT4H5M6S'),
        new DateInterval('PT36H'),
        new DateInterval('P0002-00-10T12:00:00'),
        new DateTimeImmutable('3M'),
    ];
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 8: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 9: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 10: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 11: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 12: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
<li>line 13: Malformed DateInterval specification.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "DateIntervalSpecification": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore DateIntervalSpecification

/**
 * @noinspection DateIntervalSpecificationInspection
 */
```
